q1_issues.issue: The sentence says the team's MEMBERS hold the shares, but Holder is the team witness itself — the plural subject 'Members of the QVC management team' never gets a symbol of its own.

(GroupOf sk_team_1 member) records a vacuous member kind on the team witness and stands in for that missing member group, conflating the collective with its members — the crew/committee conflation the prompt warns against.
'the remaining shares' is a definite plural, so Categorical statements requires a group witness (GroupOf <g> share), not the singular (Member sk_shares_1 share).
'remaining' is predicated of the plural symbol as a bare property, bypassing the RestOf portion encoding Partitives gives 'the remaining X'.

q2_gaps: 'the remaining X' with no antecedent whole anywhere in the text — the Partitives RestOf form needs a whole to point at
a proper-noun modifier inside a compound NP ('the QVC management team') — Compound concepts covers common-noun and adjective modifiers only
notes: Holder for 'hold shares' is defensible as possession, though the prompt's own 'the tank holds forty litres' example puts a stative transitive on Agent. (PartOf sk_team_1 qvc) is a reasonable part-whole reading of a construction the instruction set does not address.
